title: Bigfoot Sightings In Minnesota, Which Counties Lead The List?
excerpt: Minnesota has its share of strange encounters in the woods. These counties have the highest number of reported Bigfoot sightings.
content:
I was at deer camp this last weekend, and some family members were joking about Bigfoot sightings. I wouldn't call myself a Bigfoot believer, but I also try to keep an open mind about things we don't understand.

Do You Believe In Bigfoot?

We started asking each other, "Do you believe in Bigfoot?" I shared with them a story I told years ago about convincing encounters by hunters in St. Louis County. Some of them were avid outdoorsmen who never went back into the woods after what they saw. Tell me these people are lying.

Bigfoot Could Fall Under The UAP Phenomenon Umbrella

I think it's arrogant for us to dismiss credible reports of paranormal things we don't understand. The universe is far stranger than we can comprehend. It's my belief that Bigfoot, Sasquatch, Yeti, Wendigo, and other cryptid sightings fall under the UFO paranormal umbrella. I just finished Jay Stratton's book "Out Of The Shadows." It's his memoir from working for the government studying UFOs. In the book, he describes strange creatures coming out of glowing orbs that look like a werewolf. They would come out, make their presence known, and then go back in and disappear. Could some of these sightings be creatures coming from something like that? I know, it's crazy stuff.

Whether you believe in Bigfoot or paranormal creatures or not, there are plenty of reports in Minnesota of bizarre sightings. Here are the counties with the most reports, according to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.

Minnesota Counties With The Most Bigfoot Sightings

Minnesota has had its share of Bigfoot sightings over the years. There have been stories of hunters being so scared that they never go back into the woods after what they saw. Do you believe in Sasquatch? There are credible reports from multiple witnesses across Minnesota. Here are the counties that have the most sightings.
